name: @botbenchhq/botbench
description: A local-first workbench for coding agents, with controlled execution, reviewable branches, and coordination between developers.

scripts.test: node web/vendor/design-system/checker/check.mjs --config web/design-system.config.json && BOTBENCH_FAST_TESTS=1 node test/no-leftovers.ts node --test 'test/*.test.ts' 'test/!(live)/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.e2e: node e2e/prepare.ts && node test/no-leftovers.ts playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.media: node e2e/prepare.ts && BOTBENCH_MEDIA=docs playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project media
